description: Sets or replaces a project's logo. A URL is fetched right away (a failed fetch answers image_unreachable); with the npx package a local file inside SUBMITATOR_FILES_DIR (or the folder the server started in) works too.

file_path.description: A local image inside SUBMITATOR_FILES_DIR (or the starting folder), instead of url

url.description: Public image URL: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 5 MB at most

name: set_logo
title: Set the logo
